summary: Linn County lookout at Chimney Rock, built 1952 and removed in 1970 per the FFLOS record. No source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.design: Standard USFS 14x14 ft cab with catwalk on a 9 ft tower (Linn annual report); firelookout.com instead calls it a two-story L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Removed in 1970 per the Former Fire Lookout Sites record; firelookout.com says destroyed. The Forest Lookouts page lists only Removed, with no date.

staffing.status: manned from about the 15th of June, 1952

events.note: Built April and May 1952 by Linn Fire Patrol employees; completed early June. Cost $3,133. Took over duties from the Chandler Mountain lookout.
Removed in 1970 per the FFLOS record, filed under the Chandler Mountain name. firelookout.com says destroyed in 1970.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Linn annual report and the Forest Lookouts page describe a standard 14x14 cab on a 9 ft tower. Firelookout.com and the Former Fire Lookout Sites record call it a two-story L-4 cab built in 1952. The story reports both descriptions.

The Former Fire Lookout Sites record says removed in 1970, and firelookout.com says destroyed in 1970. The Forest Lookouts page says Removed with no date. The story uses 1970 and notes the difference in wording.

sources.title: Chandler Mtn. (Chimney Rock) Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Two Oregon lookouts are called Chimney Rock. This record is the Linn County site (14S-1E-27). The Jackson County Chimney Rock near Central Point (FFLOS US 776, OR 185) is a different lookout and must not be mixed with it. The brief's coordinates (44.3225, -122.6753) match the FFLOS Chandler Mountain point exactly, while sources place the 1952 tower 1.5 miles west of Chandler Mountain, so check the point on a map before using it. The kind is not a tall tower: a cab on a 9 ft tower. No source checked describes the site today. No photo added.
